description: Execution and certificate contract for the frozen-Core conformance fixture exercised through real WRL implementations in separate OS processes.

implementations.name: wrl-js-node
implementations.description: wrl.js under Node.js -- the browser identity spine running in a separate child process

implementations.name: forge-python-spine
implementations.description: Forge Python WRL spine (wrl_projection.py + wrl_canonical.py) in a separate child process

fixture_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fixture.json bytes used in this run; must match the pinned digest.

fixture_bytes_sha256.description: Independent SHA-256 of the exact input bytes fed to child processes; must equal fixture_digest_sha256.

results_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the results array, for tamper detection.

repository_revision.description: Git HEAD revision at run time.

impl_file_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the implementation file that was executed.

process_id.description: PID of the child process that computed the result. Must differ from the orchestrator PID.

computed_semantic_artifact_id.description: The sem- identifier this implementation computed from the fixture source.

verification_result.description: pass: wire bytes match; fail: mismatch; error: implementation could not run.

expected_identifier.description: The expected sem- identifier from the contract.

identifier_discrepancy.description: null when computed == expected; a diagnostic string otherwise.

invariants: Every result.process_id must differ from the orchestrator PID.
Every required implementation must have exactly one result entry.
No two results may share the same implementation_name (no duplicates).
fixture_digest_sha256 in the certificate must match the contract's pinned digest.
fixture_bytes_sha256 must equal fixture_digest_sha256 (embedded input bytes cross-check).
results_digest_sha256 must match the recomputed digest of the results array (tamper detection).
identifier_discrepancy is null if and only if computed_semantic_artifact_id equals expected_identifier.
A missing or errored required implementation makes the certificate invalid.
A certificate with zero results is vacuous and invalid.
